home.community.label: Community
home.community.title: About us
home.community.text:
The tango community in Oradea is a place where people come together not only to dance, but to connect. Here, every step tells a story, every embrace brings calm, and every melody opens a space where time slows down and presence becomes essential.

We are dancers of all ages, professions and backgrounds, united by the same wish: to live tango as a form of expression, friendship and joy. At our milongas and classes you will find smiles, support, patience and an atmosphere where everyone is welcome — whether it is your first step or your thousandth.

For us, tango is not just a dance.
It is a community.
A place where people discover themselves and one another.
A space where elegance, emotion and respect intertwine naturally.

We invite you to join us and discover the magic of tango in Oradea — where every encounter becomes a moment of shared beauty.
testimonials.label: Community
testimonials.title: What dancers in Oradea say
testimonials.t1.text: Since I danced for the first time with Francisco, I felt that he had a special presence during the dance. He was both very attentive to the music and to me. After just one private lesson with him, the leaders I danced with later noted an improvement in my connection with them. I think it will be a great experience to have him here in Oradea for three months.
testimonials.t1.name: Eva S.
testimonials.t2.text: The maestro goes beyond mere technique, he focuses on emotional connection and musicality, which has transformed my dancing and deepened my love for tango.
testimonials.t2.name: Simona F.
testimonials.t3.text: The first steps of Argentine tango were out of curiosity, but as I started to discover it, I understood that it's not just a simple dance, and it always has a mystery to explore. Each instructor, tango master, has brought something new to my experience. Argentine tango is part of my personal development.
testimonials.t3.name: Ingrid M.
